text:
mira: Heads-up — after last night's KMS maintenance I’m seeing ~600 orphaned Vault leases in staging (leases renewed earlier but not attached to any active consumer). Noticed spike around 02:15 UTC in vault-audit. Can we triage and coordinate a rotation/cleanup?
ben: yikes. do we know which mountpoints?
dalia: which KMS keys were rotated? might be related to rewrap policy change.
mira: looks scoped to secret/data/services/* and secret/data/partners/* mounts. KMS key used: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod-rr/cryptoKeys/infer-wrap (staging variant).
luis_ops: i'm on call, can take initial containment. first step: disable new writes to affected mounts and ensure read-only for consumers until we confirm.
sec-bot: action: created incident INC-2026-0482, severity: medium, owner: luis_ops. audit logs aggregated to bq:projects/redwood-prod/datasets/vault_audit.table.
ben: can we emit an audit query to narrow down which service accounts created those leases? e.g. bq query: ```SELECT auth.identity, COUNT(*) FROM `projects.redwood-prod.datasets.vault_audit.vault` WHERE timestamp BETWEEN TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(1759872000) AND TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(1759878000) AND path LIKE '%secret/data/%' GROUP BY auth.identity ORDER BY COUNT DESC;```
dalia: also check if any consumer retries flooded and kept leases alive. i’ll look for long ttl renew events in audit: ```SELECT path, metadata.lease_id, auth.identity FROM ... WHERE request_type='renew' AND ttl>3600```
mira: i grabbed one sample lease: lease_id=lease-78a2ef, created_by=svc-infer-worker@redwood, ttl=86400, last_renew=1759871700. suspect many are orphaned from autoscaler scale-down where worker died before releasing.
luis_ops: plan proposal: 1) snapshot current leases (export to gcs), 2) mark affected mounts read-only, 3) revoke leases older than 48h with no active consumer, 4) rotate any KMS keys used to wrap those secrets if rewrap failed, 5) communicate to partners. ok?
ben: add safety step: revoke in small batches and monitor failed decrypts. if apps start erroring, fallback to previous key using KMS rewrap policy.
dalia: on KMS rewrap: if key rotation happened but ciphertexts weren't rewrapped, we need to invoke `gcloud kms keys versions disable`? careful — better: use `kms.rewrap` path to re-encrypt ciphertexts with new key version. I'll draft commands.
mira: commands i used to snapshot leases: ```vault list -format=json sys/leases/lookup | jq . > /tmp/leases-snapshot.json``` then `gsutil cp /tmp/leases-snapshot.json gs://infra-dumps/incident-1759876543/`.
sec-bot: reminder: run `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log` if audit was disabled.
luis_ops: assigning tasks: ben -> run controlled batch revocations and monitor SLOs; dalia -> KMS rewrap verification and rewrap playbook; mira -> partner notif draft and mount read-only; luis_ops -> coordinate oncall and rollback plan. ETA for first batch: 30m.
ben: starting batch-1 revoke (ids: lease-78a2ef, lease-78a30b, lease-78b001). running: `vault lease revoke -prefix lease-78a` (dry-run first).
mira: partners: ping @partners-infra: "Heads-up: We observed stale secrets in staging after KMS maintenance. We will revoke stale leases in batches; if your staging workload errors, please tag this thread. ETA first batch in 30m"
dalia: verified KMS key versions. current primary version v5, previous v4 still exists. plan: use Cloud KMS rewrap API to re-encrypt with v5 where needed. snippet: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $(gcloud auth print-access-token)" -H "Content-Type: application/json" https://cloudkms.googleapis.com/v1/projects/.../cryptoKeys/infer-wrap:encrypt -d '{"plaintext":"..."}'``` (we’ll use client libs).
sre-oncall: monitoring — set alert for decrypt-errors/us-east1 > 5 within 5m window. created alert policy AP-175987.
ben: batch-1 revoke completed. observed 2 errors from svc-cache@staging. rolled back second batch. investigating.
mira: svc-cache errors: looks like it was relying on prefix-cache offline TTL. can we re-issue a short-lived secret while we rewrap?
luis_ops: yes, create temporary fallback creds with limited scope and short TTL, push via feature-flagged endpoint. I've created creds: temp-token-rot-1759 (ttl=1h). pushed to /secrets/fallback/cache-service.
dalia: rewrap job started for 200 ciphertexts. progress 40% (80/200). no crypto exceptions yet.
ben: after reverting second batch we still have ~400 leases left. bottleneck is identifying active consumers. maybe query k8s endpoints for pods referencing secret paths.
mira: good call — use audit: `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.spec.containers[]?.env[]?.valueFrom.secretKeyRef.name | contains("cache-service")) | {pod:.metadata.name, ns:.metadata.namespace}'` to find likely consumers.
sre-oncall: decrypt-error alerts stable at 0 after fallback creds, monitoring continues.
sec-bot: note: add a post-incident task to tighten RBAC: prevent long TTL renewals > 12h for non-critical services, and require lease revocation on scale-down hooks.
luis_ops: agree. I'll open a follow-up RFC for RBAC/lease-policy changes. action items summary recorded in INC-2026-0482.
mira: thanks all. will do final sweep after rewrap completes and paste logs to the incident ticket.
dalia: rewrap finished 100/200, will run integrity checks next.
ben: final revoke batch done. closing in 15m if no regressions. :thumbsup:
sec-bot: INC-2026-0482 status -> resolved by owner luis_ops at 1759876900
